profile.description: Active SCTA/BNI Bonneville land-speed event. The correct organization for Speed Week is SCTA/BNI, not the Utah Salt Flats Racing Association.

contacts.name: SCTA/BNI
contacts.role: Speed Week organizer - verify current event contact

notes.subject: Correct organizer is SCTA/BNI
notes.body: In Dec. 2023 Ellen Wilkinson of the Utah Salt Flats Racing Association told Adventure Zone it had contacted the wrong group for Speed Week and copied the SCTA office, noting Speed Week is much larger and might be interested. Current SCTA/BNI information confirms Speed Week remains active; 2026 ran July 31-Aug. 6 and 2027 information is already being prepared. Do not attribute USFRA's lack of interest to SCTA/BNI. Because the event is motorsports-focused rather than a normal family fair, keep it as a lower-priority fit review rather than automatic outreach.

followUps.label: Review 2027 Bonneville Speed Week fit
followUps.reason: The old outreach went to the wrong organization. Verify whether SCTA/BNI has a spectator/family activation area where Adventure Zone would genuinely fit before contacting them.
